head: codex/111-wp18c01-conversation-session-preparation
title: [v0.92][WP-18C.01] Implement canonical human-agent conversation sessions
body:
Closes #111

## Summary
- add Runtime-owned bounded conversation sessions with recipient binding, deterministic turn ordering, idempotency, timeout, cancellation, and reconnect retrieval
- bind asynchronous results to the exact authentication generation and credential digest
- bound duplicate attachment handling and preserve newer attachments across stale completion races
- integrate conversation admission with exact policy-visible roster detail lookup

## Validation
- conversation session tests: 1/1 PASS
- control tests: 25/25 PASS
- Observatory WSS tests: 7/7 PASS
- OpenAPI tests: 6/6 PASS
- browser conversation and combined static Observatory contracts: PASS
- strict library and binary Clippy, formatting, and diff hygiene: PASS
- focused issue-owned LLVM coverage lane: PASS
- long-running and environment-dependent proof remains out of band under #226

## Review
- independent exact-head review by subagent 019fefef-69e2-7f00-ae8f-7adbe14978e4: APPROVED with no findings
- reviewed exact product head: 078da534e9666acb443fb851ba0536fc617e0933

## Boundaries
- durable cross-restart conversation history remains owned by #114
- broader multi-agent room and routing semantics remain owned by #115 and #116
